title: A Choir Beneath the Static
subtitle: A signal mistaken for a weapon may be a request for help.
offer: After identifying a Larvaal vessel and visiting four systems, speak to Holt at Omdogan in Galaxy 4. This campaign is independent of The Glass Meridian.
story: Mining navigation receivers in Quiet Current are being drowned by repeating Larvaal phase pulses. The pulses contain synchronized gaps, not firing orders. A damaged Larvaal Probe has been trying to locate its dispersed companions while human smugglers imitate the signal to conceal their own traffic. The commander reconstructs the pulses, repairs the probe, exposes the imitation and negotiates a narrow-band rendezvous that lets both fleets navigate safely.
playerBriefing: Captain Tamsin Holt: No one has proved these pulses are an attack. Calibrate your receiver at Lobagom before approaching the source. Agent Mara Vale will compare what you find with the mining relays.
completionBenefit: A resonance-filter fitting, improving identification of this campaign's Larvaal signals. It grants no extra energy capacity, general faction immunity or free ship fabrication. A permanent clue for The Unwritten Route: The silent voice.
authoredSource: Original L337 narrative, objectives, dialogs, locations and rewards
rewardPolicy: Pay credits once, atomically with the terminal receipt. Delay optional equipment fitting if incompatible; offer it again without duplicating payment. Never award kill points for non-kills or clear unrelated legal status. Commit the clue and terminal reward receipt atomically; a pending optional fitting does not delay the clue.
branchPolicy: Record the selected evidence/protocol outcome in pack state and gossip. Branches reconverge at the next stage and share the advertised base payment.
identityPolicy: Match locations by galaxy/system identity, not coordinates or displayed spelling. Match entities by mission instance and target ID, never merely ship type.
persistencePolicy: Every campaign starts unaccepted with its current identity and zero progress. Persist current-format stage evidence, choices, mission-item custody, reward and clue receipts. Resume these records on load; replayed events cannot duplicate rewards. No previous campaign or save format is imported.

completionClue.label: The silent voice
completionClue.journalText: The restored Larvaal call contains a reply from beyond the gathering. Its pauses describe a curve, but no Larvaal vessel claims the voice.
